decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD from the firm's own label costs little to keep listed in a warehouse-backed catalog, though limited pressings may sell out over time.
The illustrated release series is a multi-model line central to the label's curated collector identity, so it is likely to be continued and expanded.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits growing vinyl demand and the firm's reissue expertise, though limited editions may go out of print.
A multi-disc box set is a premium collector item that stays in the catalog until stock runs out, which may happen with limited runs.
A compilation CD close to the core offer costs little to keep listed, though CD demand is declining and it was only mentioned briefly on the website.
